title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: K-POP Influencers
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para K-POP Influencers em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURF

IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.

We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.

Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.

Position Overview

We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.

This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.

As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.

Responsibilities

The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.

Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.

In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.

Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.

Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.

Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.

We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.

Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.

Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.

You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.

Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Network Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Senior Network Engineer provides advanced networking expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a subject matter expert and senior escalation point for complex network and firewall issues.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of network solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Network Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in enterprise networking and advanced firewall management across multiple platforms, with a strong focus on security, stability, and scalability of client environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the full lifecycle of complex network and firewall incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical network incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of network issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of network projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve network changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco, Palo Alto, and Fortinet networking and firewall equipment.
  • Conduct targeted cleanup and improvements of existing network environments to ensure stability and scalability, minimizing customer downtime.
  • Collaborate with the security team to ensure proper network hardening is in place and that all risks are properly mitigated or remediated.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Maintain awareness of developments within the networking and security technology landscape, recommending new solutions when necessary.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience within an MSP, VAR, ISP, NOC, or enterprise IT environment, with a focus on troubleshooting and maintaining existing network infrastructure.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience managing enterprise firewalls across multiple platforms — including Cisco (ASA/FTD/FMC), Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS, Panorama), and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager) — including policy design, rule optimization, VPN configuration, and threat prevention.
  • Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies including TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, IPSec, SNMP, STP, VTP, and VLANs.
  • Strong knowledge of network infrastructure within virtualized environments using VMware or similar platforms, including virtual networking, VLAN configurations, virtual switches, and network segmentation.
  • Experience troubleshooting performance and connectivity issues across different OSI layers.
  • Experience with application-level network troubleshooting, including packet inspection and analysis.
  • Proven experience optimizing, securing, and consolidating complex legacy network environments to meet current and future business needs.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a customer-first approach to resolving network issues.


Preferred

  • Active CCNP certification or equivalent (Palo Alto PCNSE or Fortinet NSE 4/7 also valued).
  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Experience with cloud networking across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including networking configurations, security settings, and integration with on-premises environments.
  • Experience with network security practices including network hardening, monitoring, and threat assessment.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience delivering customer-facing IT network projects.
  • A degree or equivalent experience in computer science or a related field.

title: Senior backend Typescript engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior backend Typescript engineer | Fully remote | B2B em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer to help build the core of its company intelligence platform. You will work on a fully serverless AWS backend in TypeScript, where clean architecture, readable code and long term maintainability matter more than clever engineering theatre.


About Fullinfo

Fullinfo is building a B2B company intelligence platform.

The platform crawls more than 300 million active domains and turns messy web data into clean, structured and searchable company profiles. Sales and marketing teams use Fullinfo to find companies, contacts and insights that are normally hidden across websites, directories, registries and industry sources.


The backend runs fully on AWS, written in TypeScript and built around serverless services like Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS. The frontend is built in Angular. GraphQL is used where it makes sense.


The team is small, international and senior. Around 11 people work across backend, frontend, UX UI, DevOps and machine learning. The culture is direct, calm and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say.


Role description

As Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer, you will work on the backend services and data pipelines that power Fullinfo’s platform.

This is not a management role or an abstract architecture role. You will write code, build services, improve data flows and make sure the backend stays simple, scalable and maintainable.

You will work closely with the CTO, principal engineer and other backend engineers. There is ownership, but not much hand holding. The direction is clear. The expectation is that you can think for yourself and build things properly.


Your work includes:

• Writing backend logic in TypeScript on AWS Lambda

• Building services across the data pipeline

• Working with S3, DynamoDB, SQS and other AWS services

• Improving performance and cost efficiency

• Keeping the architecture clean and understandable

• Writing code that is easy to read, test and change

• Collaborating with frontend engineers working in Angular

• Contributing to technical decisions as the product grows


Fullinfo values clarity over cleverness and structure over shortcuts.


Requirements

You bring:

• 5 plus years of backend engineering experience

• Strong TypeScript experience

• Real experience with AWS serverless services

• Hands on experience with Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS

• A strong instinct for clean architecture and maintainability

• Comfort working in a small remote team with minimal process

• Business level English

• You are based within 3 hours of Central European Time or are located in LATAM


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work

• Long term project with unlimited extensions


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested?

Apply trough the link.

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

description:

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, evolução e operacionalização de modelos avançados de machine learning para problemas de negócio de alta complexidade.
  • Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Estruturar abordagens robustas de experimentação, validação e monitoramento de modelos, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções.
  • Construir pipelines analíticos escaláveis para preparação, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares para transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções analíticas aplicáveis e escaláveis.
  • Liderar discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura analítica, boas práticas de modelagem e evolução da disciplina de ciência de dados.
  • Explorar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA aplicada, incluindo agentes inteligentes, automação de processos analíticos e uso de modelos generativos quando fizer sentido para o problema.
  • Apoiar a operacionalização de soluções analíticas em produção, incluindo monitoramento, performance e governança.
  • Comunicar recomendações, aprendizados e trade-offs técnicos de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros cientistas por meio de mentorias, revisões técnicas e disseminação de conhecimento.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência comprovada de 6 a 8 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Forte domínio de estatística, machine learning e experimentação.
  • Experiência sólida em modelagem preditiva aplicada a problemas complexos de negócio, incluindo previsão de demanda e séries temporais, com domínio de algoritmos de machine learning supervisionado como XGBoost, LightGBM e CatBoost.
  • Proficiência em Python e SQL para análise, modelagem e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud e ecossistemas analíticos escaláveis (BigQuery, Airflow ou similares).
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio pouco estruturados em soluções analíticas robustas.
  • Experiência com implantação, monitoramento e evolução de modelos em produção.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com IA generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de agentes.
  • Vivência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI ou similares.
  • Experiência em varejo.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.

description:

Suas atividades:

  • Automatizar processos de build, testes e publicação de bibliotecas internas.
  • Participar de revisões de código, definição de padrões e disseminação de boas práticas.
  • Investigar falhas e propor melhorias estruturais em produção.
  • Integrar sistemas legados e externos com boas práticas de interoperabilidade.
  • Colaborar com arquitetura, produto, QA e operações em soluções técnicas alinhadas ao negócio.


Perfil esperado:

  • Comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Tomada de decisão técnica com foco em simplicidade e sustentabilidade.
  • Capacidade de transformar requisitos de negócio em soluções viáveis.
  • Postura colaborativa e foco em entrega contínua.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis.

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Proficiência em Python com Django, Flask ou FastAPI.
  • Desenvolvimento backend end-to-end em arquitetura de microserviços.
  • Controle de versão (Git), build automation e gestão de dependências (pipenv, poetry).
  • Bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e uso de Redis.
  • Design e versionamento de APIs REST com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e TDD.
  • Princípios SOLID, injeção de dependência, modularidade e padrões de projeto (Factory, Strategy etc.).
  • Arquitetura cloud-agnostic com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • CI/CD e versionamento semântico.
  • Otimização de performance em aplicações Python.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em NoSQL, Elasticsearch e mecanismos de busca.
  • Clean Architecture, DDD, Hexagonal e 12-Factor App.
  • Scripts de automação (Bash/Shell) e empacotamento de bibliotecas internas.
  • Monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, CloudWatch, Splunk).
  • Vivência em ambientes multicloud e foco em otimização de custos.
  • Segurança de software (OWASP, OAuth 2.0, JWT) e governança técnica.
  • Uso de IA para produtividade (ex: GitHub Copilot).

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

title: Lab Systems Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lab Systems Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success.



Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys.



Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.



THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.


System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.


Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.



Be fully aligned to our core values:


  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Infraestrutura (Operações SaaS /Cloud /Suporte N 1).

Nossos clientes são alguns dos maiores players do mercado Global.


Sobre a área:

A área de Operações SaaS é responsável pela sustentação, disponibilidade e performance dos ambientes de clientes na nuvem, garantindo a continuidade dos serviços, o cumprimento de SLAs e a atuação proativa em incidentes e mudanças.


Responsabilidades:

Monitorar e operar a infraestrutura de clientes em ambiente OCI, garantindo disponibilidade, performance e segurança;

Executar procedimentos operacionais de rotina (start/stop de serviços, validações pós-mudança, checks de saúde, testes de conectividade, etc.);

Atuar no atendimento Nível 1, realizando triagem, análise inicial, classificação e encaminhamento de incidentes, requisições e problemas;

Registrar, atualizar e acompanhar chamados em ferramenta de ITSM, garantindo qualidade das informações e cumprimento de SLAs;

Apoiar na execução de janelas de manutenção e GMUDs, seguindo procedimentos padronizados e garantindo a comunicação com as áreas envolvidas;

Realizar análises básicas em logs de aplicação e de sistema para identificação de causas prováveis e direcionamento adequado;

Colaborar com times de Infra, Desenvolvimento e Suporte Aplicacional na investigação de incidentes e na implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas;

Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de scripts, playbooks, checklists e automações de monitoração e operação;

Participar da documentação de procedimentos operacionais, incluindo runbooks e FAQs para atendimento de primeiro nível;

Apoiar testes e validações em ambientes de certificação/homologação quando necessário;


Requisitos obrigatórios :

Experiência prévia em operações de TI, suporte técnico, infraestrutura ou NOC/Command Center;

Conhecimentos básicos em sistemas operacionais (Linux e/ou Windows Server);

Noções de redes (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, balanceamento, conectividade entre clientes e nuvem);

Familiaridade com ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmente OCI; experiência em AWS/Azure/GCP também é considerada);

Experiência com ferramentas de monitoração (infra e/ou aplicação) e abertura/atualização de chamados;

Conhecimento básico de SQL para consultas simples e análise de dados/logs;

Boa capacidade de comunicação, organização e registro de informações;

Disponibilidade para atuação em regime de plantão, escalas e janelas de manutenção (incluindo horários noturnos e fins de semana, quando necessário);


Diferenciais desejáveis:

Experiência em operações de ambientes SaaS e atendimento a clientes corporativos;

Conhecimento em OCI (compartimentos, instâncias, VCN, storage, etc.);

Vivência com ITIL (incidentes, problemas, mudanças);

Experiência com ferramentas de automação e orquestração (por exemplo, Power Automate, scripts em Shell/PowerShell, etc.);

Noções de observabilidade (logs centralizados, métricas, dashboards);

Certificações em nuvem ou infraestrutura serão consideradas um plus.

Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.
  • Prior Forecasting experience

Advanced English

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss?


Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look?


Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems?


Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?


If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role.


At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.


Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously.


This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent.


This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error.


However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Campaign Audit & Validation

  • Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, , TikTok, streaming platforms, and others
  • Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts
  • Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters


Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity

  • Identify discrepancies such as:
  • Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client
  • Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations
  • Inconsistent implementation across platforms
  • Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup


Budget & Pacing Verification

  • Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations
  • Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend
  • Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly


Tracking, Links & Technical QA

  • Verify accuracy and functionality of:
  • URLs and landing pages
  • UTM parameters and tracking links
  • Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable)
  • Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies


Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation

  • Compare campaign execution against:
  • Internal strategy direction
  • Client Success Manager requests
  • Campaign updates or pivots
  • Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely


Audit Documentation & Communication

  • Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence
  • Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error)
  • Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution


Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)


This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including:

Audit Cadence:

  • Pre-launch validation
  • Post-launch verification
  • Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits

Audit Coverage:

  • Full account audits
  • Targeted sampling across accounts

Audit Depth:

  • Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links)
  • Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)

Ownership Scope:

  • Identifying and flagging discrepancies
  • Recommending corrective actions
  • Supporting enforcement of quality standards


Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:

  • Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss
  • Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems
  • Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions
  • Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments
  • Have strong written communication skills
  • Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking)
  • Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification
  • Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools
  • Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)


Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce or CRM familiarity
  • Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors
  • Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards
  • Experience documenting processes or building SOPs
  • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment


Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Ads
  • Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • TikTok Ads
  • Ads
  • TradeDesk


Why Our Work Matters:


Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough.


That’s where Crisp comes in.


We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.


Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably.

Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022).


Crisp ( is the nation’s fastest-growing law firm growth company. We’ve helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue.

Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal.


OUR BOOK:

The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble)


OUR PODCAST:

The Game Changing Attorney Podcast


Why You Should Work Here:

  • You will work inside a structured, high-performance marketing operation
  • You will contribute to campaigns running at scale across hundreds of accounts

title: SDR Inbound / Sales Development Representative | Remoto (Brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SDR Inbound / Sales Development Representative | Remoto (Brasil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oi! Na Bizneo somos uma das maiores plataformas de HR Tech da Europa e LATAM, com mais de 30 módulos de software para gestão de pessoas :) Nosso marketing gera um bom volume de leads todos os meses — e precisamos de alguém que saiba separar o joio do trigo. Buscamos reforço para o time comercial no Brasil: alguém rápido, organizado e com bom critério para qualificar oportunidades e conectar os prospects certos com o time de vendas.


O que você vai fazer aqui?


  • Receber e trabalhar os leads gerados por marketing (formulários, demos solicitadas, downloads de conteúdo, webinars) com agilidade. Tempo de resposta importa — e muito. Este é um papel de SDR/BDR inbound: seu foco é qualificar, não prospectar do zero.
  • Fazer o primeiro contato por telefone, e-mail ou WhatsApp para entender o momento do lead: o que procura, que dores tem, qual o tamanho da empresa e se há um projeto real por trás.
  • Qualificar com critério. Nem todo lead que pede uma demo está pronto para comprar — seu trabalho é identificar quem tem fit de verdade e encaminhar oportunidades sólidas para os Account Executives.
  • Agendar reuniões qualificadas para o time de vendas com toda a informação necessária para que a conversa comece no ponto certo, sem repetir perguntas.
  • Manter o CRM impecável: registrar todas as interações, atualizar status e garantir que nenhum lead caia no esquecimento.
  • Dar feedback constante ao time de marketing sobre a qualidade dos leads: quais campanhas trazem os melhores prospects, onde o volume é alto mas o fit é baixo, o que os leads estão perguntando.


O que buscamos?


  • Experiência prévia em pré-vendas inbound, SDR, BDR, Inside Sales ou atendimento comercial em empresas de tecnologia ou SaaS. Pode ser pouca, mas tem que ser real.
  • Velocidade e organização. Você gerencia dezenas de leads em paralelo sem perder o fio nem deixar ninguém esperando.
  • Boa capacidade de escuta e de fazer as perguntas certas. Qualificar não é interrogar — é entender rápido se há um encaixe e conduzir a conversa com naturalidade.
  • Comunicação clara e empática, tanto por telefone quanto por escrito. O primeiro contato com a Bizneo é você — e a primeira impressão conta.
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultados, mas com processo. Você entende que um pipeline saudável se constrói com consistência, não com atalhos.


Pontos extra se...


  • Já trabalhou com qualificação de leads inbound em SaaS B2B, especialmente no mercado mid-market.
  • Tem familiaridade com HubSpot, Salesforce ou ferramentas de sales engagement.
  • Conhece frameworks de qualificação como BANT, SPIN ou MEDDPICC (ou pelo menos a lógica por trás deles).
  • Fala espanhol ou inglês.


O que oferecemos?


  • Teletrabalho 100% — para sempre, de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Jornada flexível de segunda a sexta.
  • Treinamento contínuo no produto e em técnicas de venda consultiva.
  • Possibilidades reais de crescimento: vários dos nossos AEs de hoje começaram como SDRs.

Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, creator management processes, and operational efficiency across projects.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring deadlines are met and quality standards are maintained.

You will architect and manage a fleet of autonomous Sales Agents that perform end-to-end prospecting, qualification, and meeting scheduling. • Experience: 4+ years in Growth or Solutions Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment.

• Sales Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Salesforce/HubSpot, Salesloft/Outreach, and data providers like ZoomInfo or 6sense.

• Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and \"reasoning loops\" to improve meeting-set rates.

title: Linux Systems Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Linux Systems Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Linux Systems Engineer

Embedded, IoT & Edge Infrastructure

DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux

SENIORITY: Mid · Senior

EXPERIENCE: 3+ years

STACK FOCUS: Yocto · WebKit


01 About the role

We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too.


02 What you'll own

  • Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack.
  • Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86).
  • Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes.
  • Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS.
  • Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware.
  • WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime.
  • Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures.
  • Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.


03 What you bring

MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux.
  • Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree.
  • Yocto or Buildroot.
  • OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions.
  • GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante.
  • Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image.
  • Shell, C/C++, Git.
  • Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs.

NICE BONUS SIGNAL

  • WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK.
  • Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack.
  • Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign.
  • Docker, CI/CD pipelines.
  • Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra.
  • Rust or Python.
  • Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS.
  • Security hardening / secure boot.


04 The kind of engineer this work asks for

  • Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads.
  • Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape.
  • Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for


APPLY

Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

Confira esta oportunidade para Arquitetura de Soluções Cloud Azure - 132725 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Arquitetura de Soluçõs em ambientes Cloud Azure .


Contratação CLT

Responsabilidades:

Será o responsável pelo desenho, definição e evolução da arquitetura técnica do programa de Data & Inteligência Artificial em Azure Cloud, garantindo que as soluções atendam aos requisitos de negócio, desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, governança e conformidade.

Atua de forma colaborativa com o Gerente de Programa, apoiando decisões estratégicas, e com os times ágeis (Scrum), assegurando que a arquitetura cloud esteja corretamente traduzida em soluções técnicas viáveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas às boas práticas da plataforma Azure.

  • Definir e manter a arquitetura de soluções de Data & IA em Azure Cloud, alinhada à estratégia do programa e às necessidades do negócio;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o Gerente de Programa, suportando decisões técnicas, mitigação de riscos arquiteturais e planejamento de capacidades;
  • Apoiar Product Owners e squads na tradução de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções técnicas aderentes à arquitetura definida;
  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de arquitetura cloud, incluindo segurança, escalabilidade, alta disponibilidade, performance e resiliência;
  • Definir padrões e diretrizes de uso dos serviços Azure, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Cognitive Services, Microsoft Fabric, entre outros, conforme o escopo do programa;
  • Assegurar conformidade com requisitos de segurança da informação, LGPD, compliance regulatório e políticas corporativas;
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias de integração, ingestão, tratamento, armazenamento e consumo de dados;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de DevOps e MLOps, garantindo automação, versionamento e governança dos ambientes cloud;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, contribuindo para otimização de custos e uso eficiente dos recursos Azure;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e consultiva ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida do programa.

Requisitos :

Arquitetura de Soluções em Microsoft Azure Cloud.

Plataformas de Data, Analytics, IA e Machine Learning.

Serviços Azure para dados e integração.Segurança, identidade e governança em cloud.

Integração de sistemas e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e dados.

Práticas de DevOps, MLOps e automação em cloud.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Data Engineering Coordinator (Remoto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Engineering Coordinator (Remoto) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa do setor de georastreamento na busca por um(a) Data Engineering Team Lead para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de dados e impulsionar a evolução da sua plataforma. Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil player-coach , capaz de equilibrar uma atuação técnica hands-on com a liderança de equipe, sendo responsável por guiar o time na construção de uma infraestrutura de dados moderna, escalável e orientada ao negócio. É essencial possuir inglês avançado ou fluente para conversação , já que a posição envolve interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais. A contratação é no modelo CLT , com atuação 100% remota .


Principais Responsabilidades:


Atuação Estratégica e Técnica

  • Atuar como engenheiro(a) sênior, participando diretamente do desenvolvimento (design, codificação e entrega de features).
  • Liderar o desenho e evolução da arquitetura de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com tecnologias modernas como Snowflake, Databricks e serviços em cloud (AWS/Azure).
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Incentivar o crescimento técnico e de carreira dos engenheiros.
  • Atuar em conjunto com Product Managers na descoberta e definição de soluções, garantindo alinhamento com necessidades do negócio.
  • Definir e garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia e metodologias ágeis.
  • Gerenciar e reduzir dívida técnica da plataforma.
  • Liderar iniciativas de análise, planejamento e execução de projetos de dados.
  • Garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos.


Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados e processos de ETL (Airbyte, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory).
  • Construir e manter infraestrutura de dados robusta e escalável.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights).
  • Garantir governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Atuar na operação de ambientes produtivos, incluindo suporte a incidentes críticos.
  • Promover inovação contínua e adoção de novas tecnologias, incluindo uso de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados, ETL e ambientes produtivos.
  • Experiência com Airbyte, Fivetran, Snowflake, Databricks e Azure Data Factory.
  • Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados (incluindo grandes volumes).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala).
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP.
  • Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto.
  • Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse.
  • Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade.
  • Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.


Formação e Experiência

  • Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on).
  • Mais de 3 anos liderando times ou iniciativas de dados.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Salesforce
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Desenvolvedora Salesforce em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Salesforce, para atuar em parceria com uma da maiores construtoras e incorporadoras do Brasil, especializada em moradia popular com qualidade e eficiência. Sendo mais de quarenta décadas de história, fazendo com que os brasileiros realizem a conquista da casa própria.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Linguagens de Programação:
  • Apex: Linguagem principal para desenvolvimento backend na plataforma Salesforce.
  • Visualforce: Usada para criar páginas customizadas, embora Lightning tenha ganho mais espaço.
  • Lightning Web Components (LWC): Framework moderno para desenvolvimento frontend em Salesforce.
  • SOQL (Salesforce Object Query Language): Para consultas em bases de dados Salesforce.
  • JavaScript, HTML, CSS: Essenciais para personalização de interfaces, especialmente com LWC.
  • Plataforma Salesforce:
  • Salesforce Administration: Entendimento de objetos padrão, objetos customizados, fluxos de trabalho, segurança, e permissões.
  • API Integration: Conhecimento em integrações com outras plataformas via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Automação de Processos: Usar ferramentas como Process Builder , Flows , e Apex Triggers para automação.
  • CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment): Uso de ferramentas como Git, Jenkins e Salesforce DX para gerenciar código e implantações.


Requisitos e qualificações

Hard Skills:


- Perfil de Desenvolvedor Salesforce

- Experiencia em desenvolvimento Back-end utilizando Apex;

- Experiencia com Salesforce Platform, Lightning Web Components, Application Lifecycle Management, Object-oriented programing

- Experiencia com Trigger, Classificações de teste, Github, Jenkins, Javascript, Web Services, SOQL/ SOSL, System integration;

- Experiencia em metodologias ágeis para desenvolvimento de software(Scrum /Kanban)

- Além da experiência como desenvolvedor, necessário ter vivência com padrão da ferramenta, como por exemplo, desenvolvimento de funcionalidades padrão Salesforce, Salesforce Cloud, entre outros.



Soft Skills:

- Insights de negócio

- Engajado e perfil proativo

- Comunicação fluída

- Atendimento ao Cliente

- Solução de problemas

- Organização

- Foco

- Resiliência

title: Engenheiro (a) FPGA - Remoto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro (a) FPGA - Remoto em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.
  • Advanced english


  • Design, simulate, implement and test digital logic for FPGA using Verilog


  • Perform synthesis, timing analysis, floorplanning and test using Xilinx Vivado and Synopsys HAPS tools. Write constraints to fix timing problems.


  • Programming skills in TCL (for Vivado and openOCD) and python.


  • Experience in board tests using JTAG probes for ARM cores, logic analyzer, serial ports, Vivado's ILA probes, etc.

  • Experience in SoC design or verification is a plus.


  • Experience in Emulation (HAPS, Zebu, Palladium) is a plus.

title: Engenheiro Eletricista - Fiscalização de Obras
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro Eletricista - Fiscalização de Obras em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

VAGA PARA SALVADOR - BAHIA

ENGENHEIRO ELETRICISTA - Fiscalização de Obras


Detalhamento do perfil: O profissional será responsável por elaborar planilhas orçamentárias dentro de seu escopo de atuação, objetivando a provisão de custos das obras civis a serem realizadas nas diversas unidades operacionais; elaborar descritivo técnico de materiais/serviços dentro de sua área de atuação; elaborar projetos de engenharia elétrica; fiscalizar obras; elaborar memorial descritivo de cada um dos serviços a ser executado, definindo especificações dos materiais a serem utilizados; prestar suporte técnico na manutenção preventiva e corretiva das unidades operacionais

  • Salário (R$ 11.926,74) + Benefícios

  • Conhecimentos técnicos e experiência exigida: Registro Ativo no Conselho de Classe (CREA-BA) e experiência comprovada, mínima de 6 (seis) meses, na função com execução de projeto, elaboração de orçamentos e fiscalização de obras.

description:

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!
